topic: Purpose and function of Altimeter and their types.
syllabus_extract: Purpose and function of Altimeter and their types. Global positioning system (GPS) introduction, purpose airborne and space components of the system. Safety precautions to be observed whilst working on avionics systems
specific_objectives: 26.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of Altimeter types and GPS components; Safety precautions for avionics work
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an altimeter?
Name two types of altimeters used in aviation.
Why is safety critical when working on avionics systems?

topics: Airborne and space components of GPS
development.content:
Basic theory of communication
Purpose and function of Altimeter
Types of Altimeters
GPS introduction and purpose
Airborne and space components of GPS

Safety precautions for avionics
Static pressure system operation
Pressure altitude vs density altitude
GPS signal acquisition basics
Maintenance of Altimeter systems

Review of Altimeter functions
GPS component integration
Safety protocol reinforcement
Troubleshooting common errors
Preparation for next lesson

summary_questions: Explain the difference between pressure altitude and density altitude.
List three safety precautions when handling avionics equipment.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the airborne and space components of the GPS system for the next lesson.
